name: Bauernhof Madlerbauer
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Madlerbauer in Ebbs is a traditional Tyrolean inn featuring its own working farm. The rooms are cozily and functionally furnished, boasting peaceful views over the lush greenery. The traditional tavern serves seasonal dishes prepared with fresh ingredients directly from the farm. Its tranquil rural location allows for undisturbed relaxation and pleasant walks starting right at the doorstep. Ebbs is located near Kufstein, serving as a prime gateway for tours into the Kaiser Mountains. Hiking trails and ski areas in the region are comfortably reachable from the property.
